method: WebFetch of each official course page on www.lboro.ac.uk (input URLs, including their ?v= query strings); fees read from the course page block "Fees for 2027-28 (per academic year)". Checked the undergraduate tuition fees page (www.lboro.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-funding/fees/) and international fees page: neither states 2027 entry fees.
